posts.title: Campaign Retrospective: Palace of the Clockwork King

As I'm about to get into refereeing an Arden Vul campaign, now seemed as good a time as any to reflect back on the choices I made when running the Palace. posts.title: Namelang: Aumspyr
posts.description: I wanted a more consistent method for generating names for my game. I figured out the phonemes that were in the names I used, and shoved them into a series of tables. posts.title: Looping Puzzle Dungeon
posts.description: This is a quick, barely cleaned up transcription of a looping puzzle dungeon that I ran a while ago.
